description.value: Brix & Mortar is a locally family-owned Canadian cuisine restaurant operating since 1999 inside a 1912 heritage brick building in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood. The space spans two floors of dining nooks, a glass-covered courtyard patio, and a heated covered patio with large screens for events. Touring cyclists passing through Yaletown will find a full dinner menu of locally sourced Canadian fare, creative cocktails, and a take-out option for meals on the go.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 86m; stands (2 spaces) at 90m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and recently updated (May 2026 timestamps), confirming Brix & Mortar is an active, open restaurant. The website explicitly lists a 'Take Out Menu' and 'Curbside Pick up' option, and the health & safety section references restrooms being sanitized, confirming washrooms exist. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; the OSM address (1138 Homer Street) is identified on the website as the Event & Wedding entrance only — the main/takeout entrance is 1137 Hamilton Street.
concerns: OSM address (1138 Homer Street) is identified on the website as the 'Event & Wedding entrance' only; the main entrance and takeout pickup is at 1137 Hamilton Street — the two-address setup may confuse cyclists navigating to the restaurant.
Phone number (604) 915-9463 is confirmed on the website but was absent from the OSM record; OSM should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant in Yaletown with a recently updated website and takeout service — a useful stop for touring cyclists in downtown Vancouver.
